                                   ASSIGNMENT AND ASSUMPTION AGREEMENT

                        This Assignment and Assumption Agreement (the "Assignment") is entered into between
               COMCELL, INC., a Texas corporation, ("Comcell"), and TEXHOMA FIBER, LLC, an
               Oklahoma limited liability company ("Texhoma"), (collectively "the Parties") to be effective as
               of January 1,2014, (the "Effective Date"). The parties enter into this Assignment pursuant to that
               Confidential Settlement Agreement and Complete Release of all Claims (the "Settlement
               Agreement") between Comcell and Community Telephone Company, Inc. (the "Comcell
               Parties") and Texhoma, Hilliary Communications, L.L.C., Edward E. Hilliary, Jr., Douglas
               Hilliary, Dustin Hilliary, and Michael Hilliary (the "Texhoma Parties").

                                                          RECITALS

                        A.        Texhoma entered into a certain Dark Fiber Lease Agreement with PEG
               Bandwidth-TX, LLC ("PEG") on May 31, 2011 and subsequently entered into a certain
               Amendment to Dark Fiber Lease Agreement with PEG on August 15, 2011 and a certain Second
               Amendment to Dark Fiber Lease Agreement on August 9, 2012 (collectively, the "PEG
               Bandwidth Contract", copies of which documents are attached hereto as Exhibit A). Pursuant to
               the PEG Bandwidth Contract, Texhoma agreed to provide dark fiber services to PEG using fiber
               optic facilities identified in the PEG Bandwidth Contract.

                      B.      The PEG Bandwidth Contract was one of the subjects of a lawsuit filed by the
               Comcell Parties against the Texhoma Parties styled, Community Telephone Company, Inc. and
               Comcell, Inc. vs. Hilliary Communications, LLC, and Texhoma Fiber FIKIA Texhoma, Inc., Douglas
               Hilliary, Mike Hilliary, Dustin Hilliary, Edward E. Hilliary, Jr., and PEG Bandwidth TX, LLC; in
               Cause No. 7:13-CV-00041-0 in the U.S. District Court of the Northern District of Texas, Wichita
               Falls Division, and previously filed as Cause No. 2013-0033A-CV, in the 97th Judicial District
               Court; Archer County, Texas, and remanded to the same court (the "Lawsuit").

                        C.      Pursuant to the Settlement Agreement in the Lawsuit resolving the claims
               between the Comcell Parties and the Texhoma Parties, the Texhoma Parties agreed to transfer
               and assign to Comcell all benefits, obligations, and liabilities under the PEG Bandwidth Contract
               and to lease certain fiber optic facilities to Comcell for the term of the PEG Bandwidth Contract.

                                                            TERMS

                         NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises herein set forth, the parties agree
                as follows:

                1.     Assignment and Assumption; Prorations; Exclusions.

                       a.       Assignment and Assumption. Texhoma does hereby assign and transfer unto
               Comcell, effective as of the Effective Date, all of Texhoma's benefits, obligations and liabilities
               under the PEG Bandwidth Contract, to have and hold the same. Subject to the provisions of
               Section l(b) below, Comcell hereby accepts such assignment and transfer and therefore agrees to
               assume all of Texhoma's benefits, obligations and liabilities under the PEG Bandwidth Contract
               pursuant to the terms of this Assignment.

                         b.       Pro-rations. The assignment by Texhoma of the rights under the PEG Bandwidth
                Contract expressly includes any maintenance fee attributable to maintenance performed from and
                after the Effective Date. As such, the parties agree that each party is entitled to their pro rata share
                of the maintenance fee paid by PEG for the month in which the Effective Date falls. The party
                who receives such maintenance fee will remit the other party's pro rata portion of such fee as
                soon as reasonably practicable after (i) the Effective Date or (ii) the remitting party's receipt of
                such maintenance fee, whichever comes later.

                         c.       Exclusions. The assumption by Comcell of the obligations under the PEG
                Bandwidth Contract expressly excludes any obligation of Texhoma (or any of the Texhoma
                Parties) not arising under or incurred in connection with the PEG Bandwidth Contract.

                        2.       Texhoma Representations and Warranties.

                      a.      Texhoma warrants that it has not assigned or conveyed any interest in or to the
                PEG Bandwidth Contract to any third party.

                         b.     Texhoma represents and warrants that it has paid all franchise fees, gross
                receipts, income, sales, use, excise and any other taxes or fees applicable to the PEG Bandwidth
                Contract due as of the Effective Date.

                        c.      Texhoma warrants that other than the claims asserted by PEG Bandwidth in the
                Lawsuit, Texhoma has not received notice of any default or claim regarding its performance of
                any obligation under the PEG Bandwidth Contract.

                      d.      Texhoma represents and warrants that the monthly maintenance fees paid to
                Texhoma under the PEG Bandwidth Contract as of the Effective Date are $9,399.84.

                         3.      Indemnification. Comcell does hereby agree to indemnify and hold harmless
                Texhoma from and against any and all claims or damages (including expenses and reasonable
                attorney's' fees) incurred or suffered by Texhoma resulting from any failure on the part of
                Comcell to discharge or perform any obligation under, or arising in connection with, the PEG
                Bandwidth Contract assumed hereunder by Comcell.

                         4.       Lease of fiber optic facilities. The Parties acknowledge that Texhoma leases
                from its affiliate Medicine Park Telephone Company ("Medicine Park") certain of the fibers used
                by Texhoma to provide service to PEG Bandwidth as described on Exhibit B, referred to herein
                as the "Burkburnett Fibers." Texhoma agrees to sublease to Comcell, for the term of the PEG
                Bandwidth Contract, the six Burkburnett Fibers described on Exhibit B at no monthly charge, to
                be used by Comcell to provide service to PEG Bandwidth pursuant to the PEG Bandwidth
                Contract. Texhoma warrants that as of the date of execution of this Assignment and Assumption
                Agreement, these fibers meet the Lease Fiber Optic Specifications in Exhibit B to the PEG
                Bandwidth Contract. Texhoma further agrees that during the term of this Sublease, Texhoma
                shall (i) maintain and repair the Burkburnett Fibers in accordance with the performance and
                maintenance standards provided in Exhibit B to the Maintenance Agreement between the Parties
                and (ii) promptly restore service in the event of a service disruption or Outage (as that term is
                defined in the Maintenance Agreement between the parties) at no charge to Comcell. In the event
                that Texhoma fails or refuses to maintain or restore the Burkburnett Fibers in accordance with the
                foregoing sentence, Comcell shall have the right to make the necessary repairs to the Burkburnett
                Fibers and shall be entitled to reimbursement for its reasonable costs incurred in making such
